properties.project_name: Piers 38 & 40 -- proposed redevelopment (San Francisco Waterfront Partners) adjacent to Mission Rock
properties.digitized_from: No Assessor block/lot exists for this Port pier facility (confirmed: DataSF's 'Parcels - Active and Retired' Socrata dataset, acdm-wktn, has no PIER-numbered street_name entries). No Port GIS shapefile or site-plan figure was available. CORRECTED 2026-09-30: the box's location is now the union of OpenStreetMap's own two named building entries for the piers -- 'Pier 40' (way 104599990, bounding box lat 37.7815294-37.7819100, lon -122.3870563--122.3855684) and 'Pier 38' (way 104599982, bounding box lat 37.7818929-37.7829023, lon -122.3879887--122.3847049), both confirmed via OpenStreetMap Nominatim on 2026-09-30 -- not a traced footprint of either building, just their combined location, since no Port GIS figure or site plan exists to trace from.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- a coarse placeholder box (the union of the two piers' real OpenStreetMap-sourced bounding boxes), not a traced footprint of the pier structures themselves, since no parcel or source figure exists for this Port facility -- see digitized_from. It does not represent the true shape or extent of either pier, only their combined location. Needs replacement with a real digitized footprint if a Port GIS layer or site-plan figure becomes available.
properties.why_no_real_parcel: Port pier facility; not on the Assessor's secured roll (data.sf.gov acdm-wktn has no PIER-numbered parcels near this site).
properties.regulatory_context: Developer: San Francisco Waterfront Partners III, LLC (SFWP), an affiliate of Pacific Waterfront Partners (PWP). Original Exclusive Negotiating Agreement: Port Commission Resolution 21-10 (2021-02-23), expired 2023-03-15 for missed performance dates. PWP separately owed the Port over $980,000 in back rent on three unrelated leases (Pier 28, two Agriculture Building suites), unpaid since it vacated them 2024-01-31. On 2026-04-28 the Port Commission adopted a Settlement Agreement (Resolution 26-21: PWP to pay $720,000 over 3 years, with the remainder of the debt forgiven on compliance) and an Amended and Restated ENA (Resolution 26-22: a 12-month 'Evaluation Period' to explore value engineering, project phasing and a new financial partner, with a new Schedule of Performance due before the period ends around April 2027). No lease, term sheet or CEQA review is in place as of this record's own last_verified date.
properties.notes: The 2022 scope estimate (~215,000 sq ft office, up to 20,000 sq ft retail, ~$528-536M cost) is explicitly under review ('value engineering', 'scope reduction') per the April 2026 Amended ENA and is not treated as current. Separately, an August 2026 marketing listing ('Pacific Cornerstone') offers up to ~279,876 sq ft of the piers for long-term lease to credit tenants, positioning occupancy for late 2029 -- parallel tenant-marketing activity alongside the Port's own Evaluation Period, not a confirmed deal.
properties.digitization_method: 2026-09-28 -- CREATED as a coarse locational box (see accuracy_caveat and digitized_from), anchored to Pier 40's real address (89 King St) at the edge of this project's cached bounding box. No owner review yet. 2026-09-30 -- CORRECTED: the box created 2026-09-28 was deliberately placed at the edge of this project's then-cached raw-data bounding box (src/config.py's BBOX_NORTH, then 37.7795), not at the piers' real location, because the real location was outside the fetched area at the time. Extending the fetch bbox north the next day (2026-09-29, for basemap coverage) brought real King St geometry close enough that it now ran through that box's interior, failing src/join_approximate.py --strict's MAJOR CLIP check (31% removed, split into 9 fragments -- a real street cutting through a block's interior, not a corner sliver, exactly the case that check exists to catch; check_geometry_quality.py --strict and check_raw_vs_processed_touching.py --strict stayed clean throughout). The fetch bbox (BBOX_NORTH=37.7812) still doesn't reach the piers' real latitude, so this project still can't be traced against locally-fetched streets/buildings -- but the piers' own location is independently known regardless of what this repo's own cached raw-data layers cover, from OpenStreetMap's Nominatim index: 'Pier 40' (way 104599990, bbox lat 37.7815294-37.7819100, lon -122.3870563--122.3855684) and 'Pier 38' (way 104599982, bbox lat 37.7818929-37.7829023, lon -122.3879887--122.3847049), both confirmed 2026-09-30. Relocated the box to the union of those two bounding boxes; it now sits well clear of any real street (0% clip). No owner review yet.
